messages:
jasper: Quick thought 11 we should insert a tiny runtime "handoff smoke" into model onboarding. something that runs in ~1min and catches the silent fails (ABI, kv continuity, perf catastrophes).

alina: love it. lower friction than full bench. what checks do you have in mind?

jasper: minimal set:
- proto/schema sanity (shapes, dtype, required fields)
- kv-replay continuity (multi-chunk prompt replay)
- perf probe (1k tokens across 4 seq lens, batching=1)
- golden-semantic quick (embeddings on 150 probes)

mike: :+1: Add an ABI fingerprint: hash serialized operator layout + quant params. quick to compute and catches reorder/packing regressions.

carla: thresholds? for perf probe we need reproducible env (pinned CUDA/driver, isolate GPU). also p95 target vs baseline.

jasper: agreed. default thresholds: perf p50 within 1.5x baseline, p95 within 2x; embedding cosine > 0.96 on model family pack; no missing required fields. all configurable by model-metadata.

alina: failure semantics are critical. maybe three actions: AUTO_REJECT, FLAG_FOR_REVIEW, ACCEPT_WITH_WARNINGS. each check should map to one.

mike: let's produce numeric failure codes so infra can branch: 1001=SCHEMA, 1002=ABI_MISMATCH, 1003=KV_BREAK, 1004=PERF_DEGRADED, 1005=DRIFT_HIGH, 1099=TIMEOUT.

ci-bot: artifact ready: https://ci.internal/runs/handoff-smoke/1764009999 (logs + compressed traces)

carla: owners? i can wire the CI job if someone builds the runner.

jasper: i'll prototype a small runner lib (py) that emits JSON diagnostics: {code, short_msg, artifacts}. mike you can do ABI fingerprint and perf harness. alina please prepare the golden prompt pack per family.

alina: on it. i'll compress prompts and embeddings and include a lite ann index for quick nearest-neighbor checks.

mike: plan: PR for perf runner by Wed, ABI tooling by Fri. can we land a staging pipeline by next week?

carla: i'll add the pipeline job (staging only) and wire auto-reporting to console. also include a --local flag for devs.

jasper: sample local command we'll expose:

```
./handoff_smoke --model rwd-delta-v1 --node staging-rt-3 --seed 123 --mode auto
```

alina: tiny detail: runner should detect quant tier and relax exact-token checks for quantized models (use edit-distance or top-k overlap).

mike: yep, will add quant-aware comparator. also adding --dump-onnx for failing runs.

carla: docs + runbook needed: where to look when AUTO_REJECT vs FLAG_FOR_REVIEW. i'll draft a short runbook and escalation path.

jasper: ok owners: jasper (runner prototype), mike (abi + perf), alina (golden packs), carla (ci + runbook). i'll open eng-ml/handoff-smoke repo and link tasks. thanks all :rocket:
